description.en: Announces the estimated spend per turn with bundled Dabaifan audio by default, with optional Alipay clips. Uses dsh-cost-meter when available, otherwise model-price estimates. All audio is bundled; no runtime speech synthesis. Code is MIT; the bundled Alipay clips come from Reathin/XVoice (no licence), the Dabaifan voice is a MiMo clone and the icon is a fan-made meme, all for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束默认用内置的大白饭音频播报本轮估算花费，可选支付宝音色；优先取 dsh-cost-meter 金额，否则按模型单价估算。音频全部内置，运行时无需联网合成。代码 MIT；随包支付宝片段来自无许可证的 Reathin/XVoice、大白饭音色为 MiMo 克隆、图标为网友二创梗图，这些素材仅限随本插件个人非商用。
